name: Go
exports_detected: Uppercase func / type / var / const identifiers
description: Go's export convention: any top-level identifier starting with an uppercase letter is exported. Detects functions, methods, types, variables, and constants. Strips single-line and block comments.

detection_rules.title: Uppercase top-level identifiers
detection_rules.description: Go's visibility rule: any identifier starting with an uppercase letter is exported. Matches func, type, var, const at the top level.

detection_rules.title: Exported methods
detection_rules.description: Method declarations (func (receiver) Name(...)) where Name starts with uppercase are also captured.
detection_rules.example_code:
func (a *Auth) Validate(token string) bool {}
func (a Auth) String() string {}

detection_rules.title: Lowercase = unexported
detection_rules.description: Identifiers starting with a lowercase letter are package-private and are excluded.
detection_rules.example_code:
func privateFunc() {}        // excluded
type authInternal struct {}  // excluded
var debugMode = false        // excluded

test_pattern_examples.explanation: Go test files — auto-excluded by convention

---
module: auth
version: 1
status: stable
files:
  - auth/service.go
---

## Purpose

Provides JWT-based auth utilities.

## Public API

| Symbol | Kind | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `CreateAuth` | func | Creates an Auth instance |
| `AuthService` | type | Auth service struct |
| `DefaultTTL` | const | Default TTL in seconds |
| `Validate` | method | Validates a JWT token |

## Change Log

| Date | Change |
|------|--------|
| 2026-01-01 | Initial |
caveats: Interface methods are not individually listed — only the interface type itself is captured.
Exported struct fields are not captured as separate symbols.
init() functions are always unexported by convention and are skipped.
